# 2) Get Venmo + Phone credentials (if needed) and log into Venmo
venmo_pw = None
for item in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if item.get("account_name") == "venmo":
        venmo_pw = item.get("password")
        break

venmo_login_doc = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="venmo", api_name="login")
venmo_login_params = [p["name"] for p in venmo_login_doc["parameters"]]

venmo_access_token = None
if "username" in venmo_login_params and "password" in venmo_login_params:
    venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(username="tra_weber@gmail.com", password=venmo_pw)
    venmo_access_token = venmo_login.get("access_token")
else:
    # If venmo login uses different parameter names, fetch supervisor email/phone and try those.
    # (We avoid guessing; we pull from supervisor profile.)
    profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
    candidate_usernames = [profile.get("email"), profile.get("phone_number"), "tra_weber@gmail.com", "7487389769"]
    for u in candidate_usernames:
        if not u:
            continue
        try:
            venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(**{venmo_login_params[0]: u, venmo_login_params[1]: venmo_pw})
            venmo_access_token = venmo_login.get("access_token")
            if venmo_access_token:
                break
        except Exception:
            pass

# 3) Find son's contact in phone contacts
#    We'll search contacts for relation/name containing "son"
contacts_doc = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="phone", api_name="search_contacts")
contacts_params = [p["name"] for p in contacts_doc["parameters"]]

# Use query param if present; otherwise fetch all contacts and filter
son_contact = None
if "query" in contacts_params:
    results = apis.phone.search_contacts(query="son")
else:
    # Fall back: show all contacts if search isn't supported as expected
    results = apis.phone.search_contacts()

# pick best match deterministically: first contact whose name or relationship contains "son"
for c in results:
    name = (c.get("name") or "").lower()
    rel = (c.get("relationship") or "").lower()
    if "son" in name or "son" in rel:
        son_contact = c
        break

# 4) Get son's Venmo identity:
#    Prefer a venmo handle/user_id in contact record; else search Venmo users by phone/email/name
son_venmo_user = None
if son_contact:
    if son_contact.get("venmo_username") or son_contact.get("venmo_handle") or son_contact.get("venmo"):
        son_venmo_user = {
            "username": son_contact.get("venmo_username") or son_contact.get("venmo_handle") or son_contact.get("venmo")
        }

if not son_venmo_user:
    # Search Venmo by phone/email/name (API-dependent)
    venmo_search_doc = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="venmo", api_name="search_users")
    venmo_search_params = [p["name"] for p in venmo_search_doc["parameters"]]
    candidates = []
    if son_contact:
        if son_contact.get("phone_number"):
            candidates.append(son_contact["phone_number"])
        if son_contact.get("email"):
            candidates.append(son_contact["email"])
        if son_contact.get("name"):
            candidates.append(son_contact["name"])
    # try each candidate until we find a match
    for q in candidates:
        kwargs = {}
        if "access_token" in venmo_search_params:
            kwargs["access_token"] = venmo_access_token
        if "query" in venmo_search_params:
            kwargs["query"] = q
        else:
            # if API uses different field name, use first non-access_token param
            non_token = [p for p in venmo_search_params if p != "access_token"]
            if non_token:
                kwargs[non_token[0]] = q
        try:
            users = apis.venmo.search_users(**kwargs)
            if users:
                son_venmo_user = users[0]
                break
        except Exception:
            pass

# 5) Determine last birthday payment amount: find last year's birthday date and look up transactions that day to son
last_year = now.year - 1
last_bday_date = f"{last_year}-{now.strftime('%m-%d')}"
start_ts = f"{last_bday_date}T00:00:00"
end_ts = f"{last_bday_date}T23:59:59"

txn_doc = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="venmo", api_name="show_transactions")
txn_params = [p["name"] for p in txn_doc["parameters"]]

page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
last_bday_amount = None
last_bday_txn = None

    if "access_token" in txn_params:

    if "page_index" in txn_params:

    if "page_limit" in txn_params:

    if "end_time" in txn_params:
        kwargs["end_time"] = end_ts

    txns = apis.venmo.show_transactions(**kwargs)
    if not txns:
        break

    # filter to payments to son on that date
    for t in txns:
        # Identify counterparty
        to_user = t.get("to") or t.get("to_user") or t.get("recipient")
        from_user = t.get("from") or t.get("from_user") or t.get("sender")
        amount = t.get("amount")
        created_at = t.get("created_at") or ""
        note = (t.get("note") or t.get("message") or "").lower()

        # ensure it's last year's birthday day (some APIs might not support time filter)
        if last_bday_date not in created_at:
            continue

        # ensure it's a payment from me to son
        # match by venmo user id/username if possible
        son_match = False

            son_id = son_venmo_user.get("id") or son_venmo_user.get("user_id")
            son_username = son_venmo_user.get("username") or son_venmo_user.get("handle")
            for u in [to_user]:
                if isinstance(u, dict):
                    if son_id and (u.get("id") == son_id or u.get("user_id") == son_id):
                        son_match = True
                    if son_username and (u.get("username") == son_username or u.get("handle") == son_username):
                        son_match = True

        # fallback: match by son's name if needed
        if not son_match and son_contact and isinstance(to_user, dict):
            if son_contact.get("name") and son_contact["name"].lower() in (to_user.get("name") or "").lower():
                son_match = True

        if son_match and amount is not None:
            # choose the most recent transaction on that day (highest created_at)
            if (last_bday_txn is None) or (created_at > (last_bday_txn.get("created_at") or "")):
                last_bday_txn = t
                last_bday_amount = float(amount)

    else:

    pay_kwargs["access_token"] = venmo_access_token
# recipient

    pay_kwargs["to_user_id"] = son_venmo_user.get("id") or son_venmo_user.get("user_id")

elif "recipient" in pay_params and son_venmo_user:

# amount + note + privacy

if "note" in pay_params:

# 1) Get Simple Note + Spotify credentials from Supervisor
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
pw_by_acct = {p["account_name"]: p["password"] for p in passwords}

# 2) Login to Simple Note
print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="simple_note", api_name="login"))
sn_login = apis.simple_note.login(username="ka_ball@gmail.com", password=pw_by_acct["simple_note"])
sn_token = sn_login["access_token"]

# 3) List all notes (paginate) and pick the most recently updated/created note that contains a list of songs
print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="simple_note", api_name="show_notes"))
notes = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.show_notes(access_token=sn_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by="-updated_at")
    if not page:
        break
    notes.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# Fetch note details and find a likely "songs" jot-down note (heuristic: contains multiple lines and at least 2 hyphens or commas)
print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="simple_note", api_name="show_note"))
candidate_notes = []
for n in notes[:50]:  # recent subset
    detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=sn_token, note_id=n["note_id"])
    text = (detail.get("content") or "").strip()
    if not text:
        continue
    lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    if len(lines) >= 3:
        # crude heuristic: looks like a song list
        score = sum(1 for ln in lines if (" - " in ln) or ("," in ln) or (" by " in ln.lower()))
        if score >= 2:
            candidate_notes.append((score, detail))

candidate_notes.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1].get("updated_at","")), reverse=False)
if not candidate_notes:
    raise RuntimeError("Couldn't find a recent Simple Note containing a song list.")
